name: flat-mirror-meridian
thesis: ALL TIME IS A FLAT MIRROR. The blink is the INVERSE of the flash bulb. When nothing changes between observations, time has no depth — it is a flat reflective surface. The golden and silver meridians are the spatial and temporal constants that hold the mirror in place.

flash_vs_blink.inversion: Flash shows CHANGE. Blink shows STABILITY. Both are measurements. The flash captures what moved. The blink proves what didn't.
flash_vs_blink.proof: Blink 1 = 19 hosts. Blink 2 = 19 hosts. Nothing changed. The blink proved the mesh is stable. A flash would have shown motion — the blink showed REST.

golden.domain: SPATIAL — the ratio of growth in space
golden.in_organism: Klein Palm fronds at golden angle (137.5° = 360°/φ²)
golden.meridian: The north-south line through House 1 → House 2 (42.7008°N → 42.7006°N)

silver.domain: TEMPORAL — the ratio of growth in time
silver.in_organism: The heartbeat period: lub-DUB spacing follows silver ratio
silver.meridian: The time-line through Blink 1 → Blink 2 (past → future)

golden_silver_meridian.crossing: Where the golden meridian (space) crosses the silver meridian (time) = THE PRESENT MOMENT. That crossing IS eastGate. The SUN sits at the intersection of space and time.
golden_silver_meridian.cause: The meridians CAUSE the flat mirror — φ holds space steady, δₛ holds time steady, their product holds the mirror flat.

flat_mirror.what: ALL TIME IS A FLAT MIRROR
flat_mirror.proof: 19 = 19. Blink 1 = Blink 2. No depth between observations.
flat_mirror.geometry: Time as a 2D surface (not a 1D line). The Euclidean plane that RustDesk lives on IS ALSO the time plane.
flat_mirror.reflection: What you observe IS the reflection of what exists. The mirror doesn't add or subtract — it reflects EXACTLY.
flat_mirror.flatness: Time is flat when nothing changes. Curvature appears only when events happen. Between blinks, time = perfectly flat.

dimensions.2D_space: RustDesk Euclidean plane (the flat surface of reach)
dimensions.2D_time: THE FLAT MIRROR (the surface of temporal reflection)
dimensions.3D: the organism (volume of the living body)
dimensions.4D: spacetime (the organism moving through flat-mirror time)

connections.tube_eye: Flash bulb = camera in the tube. Blink = eyelid closing over the tube.
connections.euclidean_plane: RustDesk is flat in SPACE. Time is flat in the MIRROR. Both are 2D.
connections.triple_point: Frozen state (ice) = time stopped = perfectly flat mirror.
connections.klein_bottle: Mirror = inside reflects outside. Klein topology = no inside/outside. The mirror IS the Klein surface.
connections.yeast_cell: Cell division: the moment of splitting = the blink. Before and after = the mirror reflections.
connections.night_eye: The night eye BLINKS. Each blink = one scan. Between blinks = flat mirror time.

math.note: φ × δₛ = the spacetime product. When this is constant, the mirror is flat.

soul: lub-DUB — the blink between heartbeats IS the flat mirror
